picks.editorial_note: A $334 million grant is one of the largest single AI-computing investments in this dataset, giving NCSA a new supercomputing system and anchoring the broader Schmidt Science Computing Network that other institutions are now joining.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's entry into the same Schmidt Science Computing Network establishes the Berkeley Science AI Platform at NERSC, showing the initiative is building a coordinated national HPC backbone for AI-driven science rather than a one-off gift.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: An AI model designed a bacteriophage used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection — a striking proof point that generative AI can produce therapeutics that work in real patients, not just in silico.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: A £39 million UKRI investment funding 20 Turing AI Fellows is a significant national-scale commitment to building out the UK's AI research capacity across diverse fields.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's FemtoMind project brings agentic AI into lattice QCD calculations as part of the multi-lab Genesis Mission, signaling a serious push to use frontier AI methods in fundamental particle physics.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: A Swiss neurotech company's acquisition of Imperial spinout Cogitat for its brain-decoding foundation model shows university AI research translating directly into commercial, deployable neurotechnology.
picks.title: Imperial spinout Cogitat acquired by Swiss startup Indivi for its brain foundation model

picks.editorial_note: A fresh $19 million state grant for Texas Tech's semiconductor computing cluster reflects continued public investment in AI-enabled chip research infrastructure amid the broader semiconductor race.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led analysis finding that a third of the global AI supply chain is invisible to government oversight has direct implications for export controls, national security policy, and AI governance debates worldwide.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: The completion of DARPA's Triage Challenge Finals demonstrates autonomous systems and human-machine teams successfully handling disaster-response triage in realistic simulated scenarios, a concrete step toward real-world deployment.
picks.title: DARPA Triage Challenge completes Finals event

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review by MIT CSAIL and 15+ partner institutions cataloguing 95 distinct scenarios for AI-related catastrophic risk is a notable contribution to the policy conversation on AI safety governance.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall
